#### NHC Adjustment Tab

The NHC Adjustment tab shows adjustments that were made for non-hydrocarbon liquid meters. These include current period adjustments (CPA) and prior period adjustments (PPA).



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 660;height: 319;" />

The following items are available on this tab:

- **Effective Date** - The date for which the data is applicable. This is dependent on contract day, contract hour and Resolution. For Hourly Resolution, the effective date will be the day and hour the data is effective for. For Daily Resolution, the effective date will be at the contract hour for the given day. For Monthly Resolution, the effective date will be at the contract day and hour for the given month.
- **Activity Codes** - Activity codes can be meter events, alarms, analysis changes or other items as selected on the Rollup Configuration Editor. FLOWCAL calculates these at the hourly, daily, monthly and batch level. The user can choose which ones will appear by going to [System Rollup Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/System/Rollup%20Configuration.md) and checking or unchecking options in the Activity Codes section.
- **GSV** - GSV is the gross standard volume before PPAs are made.
- **Adj GSV** - Adj GSV is the adjusted total gross standard volume for the period. It includes any CPAs and PPAs.
- **Mass** - Mass is the mass before PPAs are made.
- **PPA Mass** - PPA Mass is the prior period adjustment to the Mass. This is the amount of any proving adjustment(s).
- **Adj Mass** - Adj Mass is the adjusted mass for the period. It includes any CPAs and PPAs.
- **GMS Date** - GMS date is the date that the data was written to the database.
